Overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) were primary endpoints, objective response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), and safety were secondary endpoints. Results Totally 55 patients were included, 15 in resectable group and 40 in unresectable group. The median follow-up was 36.70 months and 34.00 months, respectively. 已修改并保存（同名覆盖，原文件已自动备份为 `manuscript.docx.bak`）。

**改了什么**

位置：Discussion 中以“Importantly, clinical outcomes in patients aged ≥ 75 years…”开头的那一段（该段讨论 PS ≥ 2 亚组预后较差）**末尾**，新增一句（以 Word 修订标记的插入形式，作者 Claude，供你在 Word 中接受/拒绝）：

> Similarly, Kao et al. [19] reported that, in patients with unresectable advanced or metastatic ESCC, nivolumab plus chemotherapy improved the ORR (72.0% vs. 66.67%, p = 0.038) and prolonged median OS (609 days vs. 392 days, p = 0.04) compared with chemotherapy with or without radiotherapy, although outcomes were not stratified by performance status; these data therefore support the efficacy of ICI-based regimens in advanced ESCC but do not allow a direct comparison with the present findings in patients with a performance status of ≥ 2.

数据来源与核对：Kao MW 等，*Int J Mol Sci*. 2023;24:7312（doi:10.3390/ijms24087312, PMID 37108474），即文献表第 19 条，该段原本已引用过 [19, 20]，故沿用 [19] 编号，未新增参考文献条目。报告的具体数字为 ORR 72% vs 66.67%（p = 0.038）、中位 OS 609 天 vs 392 天（p = 0.04）。

**一点需要你确认的地方**

Kao 等（2023）这篇真实世界研究比较的是“纳武利尤单抗＋化疗” vs “化疗（±放疗）”，其报告结果中**并未按 PS 分层**，也没有 PS ≥ 2 亚组的 PFS/OS 数据。所以我没有把它写成“与本研究 PS ≥ 2 的结果一致/不一致”，而是明确注明该研究未按 PS 分层、只能间接支持 ICI 方案的总体获益。如果你希望换一种表述（例如干脆放到段中“…lacking”之后，或改用 Kim 等[20]的 PS 相关数据作对照），告诉我即可调整。

## 修改内容

**Discussion 中以 “We also explored the associations between peripher…” 开头的段落**（paraId 13AED1CA），共 4 处改动，全部以 Word 修订标记（track changes，作者 Claude）记录：

|---|---|---|
| 1 | After adjusting for baseline patient characteristics and multiple comparisons **in multiple multivariate Cox regression analyses**, | After adjusting for baseline patient characteristics and multiple comparisons**,** |
| 2 | These results are **generally** consistent… | These results are consistent… |
| 3 | …our previous studies [32, 33] and **those of other investigators** [34–37] | …and **others** [34–37] |
| 4 | …for prognostic prediction in patients **with advanced esophageal cancer** treated with ICIs. | …in patients treated with ICIs. |

**改后的整段：**

> We also explored the associations between peripheral blood parameters and survival in patients with advanced esophageal cancer treated with camrelizumab. After adjusting for baseline patient characteristics and multiple comparisons, baseline normal LMR, albumin, PLR, and NLR were associated with better OS. These results are consistent with our previous studies [32, 33] and others [34–37], suggesting that these easy-access biomarkers might be useful for prognostic prediction in patients treated with ICIs.

- 字数约从 **93 词减至 74 词**（约 −20%），论证链条（探索性分析 → 校正后结果 → 与既往文献一致 → 临床意义）完整保留，参考文献编号 [32, 33]、[34–37] 未改动。
